title: Essay Topic and Prompt Matcher
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Test a candidate essay topic against the qualities of a strong personal story, and see which Common App prompts it fits.

learningObjectives: Students will assess a candidate essay topic against criteria for a strong personal story and select the Common App prompts it fits.

keyQuestions: Why should you choose the story before the prompt?
What makes a common topic work anyway?
Why does a single moment often make a stronger essay than a long summary?
commonMisconceptions: The prompt you choose matters more than the story.
assessmentOpportunities: Students evaluate two candidate topics and justify choosing one using specificity, what it reveals, and its meaning.
